nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address with privileged control over the contract; initialised from the deployer.
ReentrancyGuard.reentrancyLock: boolean mutex toggled by the nonReentrant modifier.
IndTokenPayment.path: array of IERC20Token describing the Bancor conversion path.
IndTokenPayment.destinationWallet: recipient of converted tokens / withdrawn funds.
IndTokenPayment.minConversionRate: minimum acceptable conversion rate.
IndTokenPayment.bancorRegistry: contract registry used to resolve the BancorNetwork address.
Constant bytes32 label used to look up the BancorNetwork contract in the registry.
Ownable constructor: assigns the deploying account as owner.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access restriction.
renounceOwnership: owner-only function that sets owner to address(0).
transferOwnership: owner-only function that delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership: internal routine that validates and writes the new owner.
nonReentrant modifier: sets and clears reentrancyLock around the guarded body.
IndTokenPayment constructor: initialises path, registry, destination wallet and min rate.
setConversionPath: owner-only setter for the Bancor conversion path.
setBancorRegistry: owner-only setter for the Bancor contract registry.
setMinConversionRate: owner-only setter for the minimum conversion rate.
setDestinationWallet: owner-only setter for the destination wallet.
convertToInd: internal nonReentrant routine that swaps msg.value for tokens via Bancor.
withdrawToken: owner-only nonReentrant rescue of accidentally sent ERC20 tokens.
withdrawEther: owner-only nonReentrant rescue of ETH locked in the contract.
Payable fallback: forwards received ETH to convertToInd.
getBancorContractAddress: view helper returning the resolved BancorNetwork address.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership and event emission.
Unsafe write of the privileged owner variable in the Ownable constructor.
require(msg.sender == owner): access-control check guarding privileged functions.
External call bancorNetwork.convertFor.value(msg.value)(...) to an address resolved at runtime.
External ERC20 transfer of anyToken from this contract to destinationWallet.
destinationWallet.transfer(address(this).balance): external ETH send.
owner = address(0): permanently renounces ownership.
owner = _newOwner: privileged ownership transfer write.
reentrancyLock = true / false: mutex set and cleared around guarded bodies.
External call bancorRegistry.getAddress(BANCOR_NETWORK) resolving the network address.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter _newOwner of _transferOwnership.
Constructor parameter _path holding the initial conversion path.
Constructor parameter destWalletAddr for the destination wallet.
Constructor parameter bancorRegistryAddr for the registry contract.
Constructor parameter minConvRate for the minimum conversion rate.
Parameter _path of setConversionPath.
Parameter bancorRegistryAddr of setBancorRegistry.
Parameter minConvRate of setMinConversionRate.
Parameter destWalletAddr of setDestinationWallet.
Parameter anyToken of withdrawToken whose transfer target is externally supplied.
Local minReturn hardcoded to 1 inside convertToInd.
Local convTokens holding the return value of the Bancor convertFor call.
Local bancorNetwork instance cast from the registry-resolved address.
